title: BIOLOG tenant data binding
description: ADR-0002 Decision 4.1. Control-plane record mapping a resolved tenant to its database. Looked up by tenant_id and NEVER supplied by a request: no caller may name a database, schema, host, connection string or binding key. Only status ACTIVE routes.

binding_key.description: Opaque handle the infrastructure layer exchanges for a connection. Deliberately not a connection string: credentials are not contract data.

not.$comment: Credentials and addresses never travel as contract data (Master Spec section 13; Tenant Domain Routing).
